moments.title: Premier League Kicks Off 2026/27 Season
moments.blurb: The 2026/27 Premier League season begins this Friday, August 21st, with Arsenal hosting Coventry City in the opening match.

angles.name: Opening Weekend Excitement
angles.copy: Football's back! The Premier League 2026/27 season kicks off this Friday. Who's ready for the return of top-flight action? #PremierLeague #FootballIsBack

moments.title: GB's Alex Medley Wins Boccia World Gold
moments.blurb: British boccia player Alex Medley, 21, has won a gold medal at the World Boccia Challenger in Poznan, Poland, after a phenomenal 9-0 victory in the final.

angles.name: Boccia Gold for GB
angles.copy: Huge congratulations to Great Britain's Alex Medley, 21, for winning gold at the World Boccia Challenger! A dominant 9-0 win in the final. Incredible! #Boccia #TeamGB

angles.name: UK Sporting Hero
angles.copy: Another UK sporting hero! Alex Medley brings home World Boccia gold. What an achievement for the 21-year-old. #SportingExcellence #GB

moments.title: Madonna & Kylie Minogue Debut in Top 10
moments.blurb: Madonna and Kylie Minogue's collaboration 'Love Sensation' has debuted at number 8 on the Official UK Singles Chart this week, marking Madonna's 65th and Kylie's 37th Top 10 single.

angles.name: Pop Queens Unite
angles.copy: Pop royalty! Madonna and Kylie Minogue's 'Love Sensation' is a brand new Top 10 hit on the Official UK Singles Chart. An iconic collaboration! #Madonna #KylieMinogue

angles.name: Chart Legends
angles.copy: Still making history! 'Love Sensation' gives Madonna her 65th and Kylie Minogue her 37th UK Top 10 single. Legends! #OfficialCharts #PopMusic

moments.title: Sam Fender & Olivia Dean Hold UK No.1
moments.blurb: Sam Fender and Olivia Dean's 'Rein Me In' remains at number 1 on the Official UK Singles Chart, extending its reign as the longest-running UK number-one single of all time.

angles.name: Chart Reign Continues
angles.copy: Still at the top! Sam Fender & Olivia Dean's 'Rein Me In' is the Official UK Number 1 again. A record-breaking run that just keeps going! #SamFender #OliviaDean

angles.name: Longest Running No.1
angles.copy: History made! 'Rein Me In' by Sam Fender & Olivia Dean is officially the longest-running UK No.1 single ever. That's a serious achievement! #UKCharts #NumberOne
